review.notes: Token-level diff of extracted text from all 17 physical PDF pages against the OCR markdown; all evaluation tables (biorisk tooling, safety evaluations, browser benchmarks), appendix prompt text and prose match. Remaining deltas are per-page footers, hyphenation joins, screenshot-internal text and reading-order differences inside the 'Watch, Rate, and Intervene' table. One swallowed placeholder pair and one dropped footnote body were repaired.
